the increase of hardness is closely related to the volume fraction of the second phase. The increase of the volume fraction of the second phase leads to the increase of the hard phase in the alloy, so the hardness of the alloy is improved significantly
the addition of Al atoms is more inclined to form substitutional solid solution, which strengthens the properties of the alloy
Obviously, the strengthening effect of Al can be attributed to the second-phase strengthening (Laves phase).
every element in the AlxNb0.5TiV2Zr0.5 alloys can be regarded as both solute atom and solvent atom, and has the same chance to occupy the lattice, which will cause a serious lattice distortion effect

Due to the absence of Zr, the volume fraction of the second phase does not change any more, and Al can only be solidly dissolved into the matrix. Excessive solid solution of Al in the matrix increases lattice distortion and reduces ductility
The mainly strengthening mechanism of AlxNb0.5TiV2Zr0.5 alloys is the second (Laves) phase strengthening.
